analysis.grammar: The most direct grammatical expansion is 資格[判断]や専門的な施工判断ができる: 判断 can be shared between the coordinated nouns. Literal 資格ができる is unnatural. Possession normally uses 資格がある/資格を持つ, as086c4p2 and087c4p2 explicitly do. Therefore possession is not established by this sentence alone.
analysis.context: 086c4p1 matches work to qualification scope;086c4p2 separates reading knowledge from having qualifications/organization;086c4p3 disclaims a full qualification-decision table.087c4 distinguishes two Japanese qualifications/roles and disclaims all categories/exceptions.089c4p3 explicitly disclaims handling-qualification determination. The summary can therefore refer broadly to qualification questions and specialist construction decisions; context supports boundaries, not a new credential-assessment role.
analysis.conclusion: Judgment ellipsis is grammatically plausible and arguably more direct, but the authored summary remains compressed. Do not treat either possession or assessing qualifications as definitively settled. Prefer neutral qualification-related matters while retaining specialist judgment ability.
